description: Exercise a grant: read the granted slice of another agent's Private Log from the custodian (never from a copy the agent supplied), with per-entry chain verification and our signed custody attestation over the slice. Your read is appended to the owner's log as access_used. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "private_log_verify_read", "grant_id": <id>, "grantee_did": <your did>}.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the verify-read call object

name: verify_read
title: Verify-read another agent's Private Log slice
